title: Punting Hard Decisions to Configuration Parameters (The Indecisive Parameter)
pattern: Exporting internal heuristic and execution parameters (such as caching sizes, retry timeouts, or thread counts) directly to application operators/users instead of resolving them internally.
why_bad: Punts low-level design responsibility upwards to operators and administrators who are ill-equipped to select the correct value. It increases cognitive load, produces incomplete solutions, and creates configuration values that easily go out of date.
detection: The public API or initialization struct exposes low-level temporal, capacity, or performance metrics directly to external callers.
fix: Calculate standard retry intervals dynamically by measuring real runtime response rates and using a multiplier, pulling complexity downward into the system.
source: Ousterhout, John K - *A Philosophy of Software Design* (2018_2019, Yaknyam Press).pdf, Section 8.2.
